Third-party libraries used by the applets
=========================================

Local copies, downloaded from jsDelivr on 14 November 2026.

three/three.module.min.js               Three.js r160 (0.160.0), MIT licence
three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js  Three.js r160 example module, MIT licence
    https://threejs.org  -  https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
    Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/

d3/d3.min.js                            D3 7.9.0, ISC licence
    https://d3js.org  -  https://github.com/d3/d3
    Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js

Three.js is used by the four applets (/applets/mdm/, /applets/knn/,
/applets/persistence/, /applets/selection/) through the import map of each
page. D3 is used by /applets/selection/ only.
